description.p: You are an untrained individual with no formal combat training.
Untrained, you gain the following class features.

ul.li: Hit Points at 1st Level: 4 + your Constitution modifier
Hit Points at Higher Levels: 1d4 (or 3) + your Constitution modifier per level after 1st

description.p: You start with no equipment, except for the equipment granted by your background

sheet.description: An untrained individual with no formal combat training.
